title: Bliss
description_html: The organically abstract allover design evokes a range of associations – shimmering water droplets, the veining of a rare gemstone, or the coat of a wildcat – fluid, layered, and naturally elegant. Varying pile heights capture the light and transform it into soft tonal gradations. The result is a surface that shimmers differently from every angle – sometimes with a silky glow, sometimes with gentle depth. Available in twelve colorways, from radiant and fresh to deep and sophisticated, BLISS reveals itself as a velvet of shimmering refinement – a fabric that captures the fleeting beauty of a moment.

title: Cedro
description_html: This decorative upholstery fabric unfolds its character in a delicate balance of movement and calm. The marbled jacquard weave features a tone-on-tone pattern whose lines glide across the surface like flowing water. The interplay of voluminous bouclé yarn and a matte satin base creates a subtle relief structure that gently shapes the woven surface. Fine contour lines accentuate the moiré-like texture of the motif, bringing the visual relief clearly to life.

title: Loggia
description_html: LOGGIA plays with the idea of woven structure – clean, graphic, yet naturally appealing. With its impressive depth and embossed relief effect, the surface recalls handcrafted raffia weaving. The material demonstrates how effortlessly function and style can come together: easy to maintain, lightfast, and washable, while exuding cool elegance and tactile presence. Whether in a subtly designed salon interior or an airy spa environment, LOGGIA fits seamlessly into a wide range of settings thanks to its excellent care and performance properties. The woven look feels both modern and timeless – an upholstery fabric with architectural character that gracefully blurs the boundaries between indoors and out.

title: Rythm Delight
description_html: Rythm Delight is an upholstery fabric that captivates with its fascinating interplay of sheen and texture. On an elegant satin ground unfolds a delicate allover texture of matte bouclé yarn, giving the fabric depth and vibrancy. The jacquard pattern appears almost like a relief – subtle yet expressive – creating a harmonious tension between lustrous elegance and soft matte finish. Whether on a single chair or expansive upholstered surfaces, the fabric transforms every piece into a stylish statement. RYTHM DELIGHT plays charmingly with light and shadow, lending interiors a refined, distinctive presence that feels both understated and remarkable.

title: Infinity Tweed
description_html: This upholstery fabric combines the grace of traditional craftsmanship with contemporary functionality. The multicolored structured flat weave evokes a lively tweed, enhanced by subtle bouclé accents that lend the surface a slightly irregular, organic texture. Coarse and fine yarns create a harmonious play of color, giving each piece of furniture its own distinctive character. Beneath its natural appearance lies a sophisticated high-tech composition: easy to care for, durable, and pleasantly soft to the touch, this fabric perfectly balances aesthetics and everyday practicality. Whether used to upholster chairs, sofas, or casual cushion arrangements, the fabric conveys the warmth of handcrafted materials while meeting modern standards. INFINITY TWEED is produced in Germany in a climate-neutral process using European-sourced yarns.

title: Infinity Raya
description_html: Infinity Raya is a contemporary interpretation of the classic stripe motif. Velour ribs with a fine high-low effect lend the surface of this upholstery fabric a three-dimensional depth, its contours accentuated by delicate, color-contrasting lines. The fabric combines comfort, easy care, and durability, offering excellent functional properties. It is washable, easy to clean, features outstanding lightfastness, and is suitable for allergy sufferers. Produced in Germany using European-sourced yarns, it is part of the INFINITY product family.

title: Bamboo
description_html: Generous block stripes rest like artfully strung pearl bands upon a densely woven satin warp. The brocade-woven stripe motifs capture the light, creating a decorative interplay of matte and sheen. The fabric’s sumptuous, fluid drape lends this extravagant decorative textile a sense of luxurious opulence that enriches windows and interiors with atmosphere and depth. Whether used as a curtain, room divider, or wall covering, BAMBOO unites refined textile tradition with a feeling of modern luxury.

title: Lucky Charm
description_html: Inspired by the tranquility and beauty of Asian water landscapes, Lucky Charm features cranes, symbols of happiness and longevity in Asian culture, gliding gracefully through a freshly blossoming spring scene. Flowers and leaves glow in the clear light that follows a refreshing rain shower. Crafted in the finest jacquard technique, the expansive design reveals its charm through intricate detail and luminous, refined coloration.

title: Mato
description_html: MATO reveals its charm through subtle nuances. On a delicately shimmering ground, horizontal lines appear like a fine mesh laid across the surface, gently accentuating the play of color. The base gains its vitality from the slight sheen of the floating warp yarns, which create a lively wave-like texture on the surface. Every movement, every shift of light unveils new facets of this finely woven jacquard, enhancing the impact of its fourteen elegant colorways. Here, minimalism becomes a sensory experience — a fabric for connoisseurs who appreciate refined details and sophisticated materiality.

title: Iriza
description_html: Iriza is a floor-to-ceiling taffeta fabric that impresses with its firm structure and shimmering luster. Its densely woven quality gives the textile its distinctive taffeta body, allowing for a dramatic drape that unfolds its full effect, especially in generous curtains. The extensive palette of 30 sophisticated colorways captivates with refined, iridescent nuances created through the interplay of warp and weft threads. IRIZA unites understated elegance with sculptural presence.

title: Ishari
description_html: This floor-to-ceiling drapery fabric celebrates the quiet beauty of restraint. Two ultra-fine woven layers encase loosely bound effect yarns whose subtle bouclé character lends the surface a gentle vitality. The result is a textile balance between openness and structure, transparency and volume. The color palette features exclusively neutral natural tones that integrate effortlessly into a wide range of interior concepts. With its easy-care properties and understated appearance, ISHARI becomes a timeless companion for contemporary interiors.

title: Chaconia
description_html: The generously scaled Scherli design unfurls in gentle movement across the transparent ground — a weave of leaves, branches, and grape-like blossoms that reveal their full allure in backlight. The refined balance between dense and translucent areas creates a delicate interplay of light and shadow, lending the room a poetic atmosphere. Subtly metallic accents within the blossoms add shimmering highlights and give the design a modern, luxurious touch. A decorative fabric that artfully blurs the line between indoors and outdoors, between natural beauty and refined elegance.

title: Nuri
description_html: Nuri is a subtle fabric that fills interiors with an authentic sense of character. This floor-to-ceiling check weave plays with the contrast between transparency and density, creating a textile graphic of great calm and precision. Yarns of varying thickness and differing weave densities form a fine grid reminiscent of the crosshatching in a drawing — lively, natural, and uncontrived. The gentle irregularity of the effect yarns gives the fabric its distinctive signature: an engaging interplay of line and surface, craftsmanship and lightness.

title: Silvan
description_html: This embroidered sheer fabric captures the charm of effortless ease. Organic lines flow across the airy ground, stitched tone-on-tone in a rhythmic zigzag pattern — sometimes dense, sometimes freely meandering. The result is a lively allover design reminiscent of handcrafted embroidery, giving the textile a charming artisanal touch. A modern classic infused with a sense of lightness and the feeling of a summer breeze within the room.

title: Niket
description_html: A fabric that captivates through its effortless naturalness. The semi-transparent grid weave, crafted in a classic leno technique, reveals an open structure and a pleasantly fluid drape. A special, gentle finish gives the textile its characteristic volume and natural irregularity — almost as if it were handmade. The look is deliberately understated, exuding a calm, relaxed elegance that lends any room a subtle warmth. Made from high-quality polyester yarns, NIKET combines authentic natural appeal with easy care and modern everyday practicality.

title: Poona
description_html: This airy design is named after the Indian city of Pune, formerly Poona, home to the magnificent Aga Khan Palace. Poona draws inspiration from the palace’s graceful arches and is printed on a vinyl base with a realistic, evenly woven linen texture.

title: Agra
description_html: Agra is an abstract flower design printed on an elegant vinyl base that mimics the texture of handwoven linen. It draws inspiration from the flowering plants that color the landscape in spring, as well as the floral garlands found in countless street stalls.

title: Kerala
description_html: The swaying palms along the riverbanks of the Indian state of Kerala inspired this panoramic design. Its graceful lines stand out beautifully on the vinyl base, which has the relaxed, open-woven texture of linen.

title: Kashmir
description_html: Kashmir is a panoramic design inspired by the colourful shawls of India, printed on a vinyl base with the texture of evenly woven linen.

title: Mandu
description_html: Named after the historic Indian city of Mandu, this understated design is a vinyl with the elegant, airy look of handwoven linen. Its open weave reveals subtle irregularities, highlighting its artisanal character. Mandu is available in a beautiful palette of warm, natural colours.

title: Bundi
description_html: This plain design offers a remarkably realistic interpretation of timeless linen, with an exceptionally matte vinyl finish. Its even weave creates a calm, balanced effect. Bundi, named after the charming Indian town, is available in a rich palette of warm, natural colours.

title: Pampelonne
description_html: Pampelonne is a double width, open-weave voile fabric made from 100% linen. The yarn supplier, based in Belgium, are certified Masters of Linen as well as being European-Flax and Oeko-Tex-certified. The long linen fibers guarantee robust quality. The fabric is woven in a traditional textile mill in France, 20 minutes away from our design studio. The fabric is piece-dyed and then stabilized with a gentle stone-wash finish, ensuring softness and a distinctive touch.

title: Amarna
description_html: Amarna is a rich and lively design, loosely inspired by the organic layout of a bustling city. Named after the ancient Egyptian city surrounded by fertile valleys on the eastern bank of the Nile, it is crafted in a soft, luxurious 3D textile that enhances its dynamic, vibrant feel.

title: Sakkara
description_html: Sakkara takes its name from the necropolis near Memphis, world-famous for its many pyramids, including Pharaoh Djoser’s iconic step pyramid. This pattern is inspired by the breathtaking desert landscape and evokes the architectural rhythm of the pyramids through layered structures and rectangular forms. The velvety 3D textile gives the design a remarkably vibrant presence.

title: Ibis
description_html: The Ibis design features tall panels depicting the verdant green riverbanks of the Nile, rendered in a soft relief textile. Among the lush foliage, the graceful ibis - a bird rich in ancient Egyptian symbolism - occasionally appears, adding a poetic touch to the design.

title: Siwa
description_html: The Siwa design draws inspiration from the distinctive texture of the palm trunk, subtly referencing the remarkable trees that symbolize life in the desert. This design exudes warmth thanks to the soft, tactile relief textile.

title: Abydos
description_html: This intriguing geometric pattern, Abydos, is composed of strong lines moving in different directions, inspired by the characteristic structures of the temples of Abydos, one of Egypt’s oldest and most spiritual cities. The soft 3D textile amplifies the dynamic effect, truly bringing the design to life.

title: Parallel Universe Raspberry
description_html: Parallel Universe Raspberry is a high-end contemporary fabric from S. Harris, known for its innovative colors. This fabric is made from 53% Acrylic and 47% Polyester, with a weight of 31.54 ounces per linear yard. It is suitable for upholstery and features a texture plain design in a red color. The fabric is produced in Turkey and meets various standards including Oeko Tex Standard 100 and ISO 14001.

title: Parallel Universe 11
description_html: Parallel Universe 11 is a high-end contemporary fabric from S. Harris, featuring a texture plain design in a modern style. It is made of 53% Acrylic and 47% Polyester, suitable for upholstery use. The fabric is durable, exceeding 51,000 double rubs (Wyzenbeek Method), and meets various fire and environmental standards.

title: Wind Chime Ocean
description_html: Wind Chime Ocean is a high-end contemporary fabric from S. Harris, featuring an exclusive pattern with a large scale abstract design. Made from 100% linen, it is suitable for bedding, drapery, and multipurpose uses. The fabric is reversible and dry clean only, with fire codes UFAC Class I / NFPA 260 and exceeds 51,000 double rubs (Wyzenbeek Method).

title: Wind Chime Ivory
description_html: Wind Chime Ivory is a high-end contemporary fabric from S. Harris, featuring an exclusive print pattern. It is made of 100% linen and is suitable for bedding, drapery, and multipurpose uses. The fabric is reversible and dry clean only, with a large scale abstract design in linen and off white/ivory colors. It exceeds 51,000 double rubs, ensuring durability.

title: Wind Chime 01
description_html: Wind Chime 01 is a high-end contemporary fabric from S. Harris, featuring an exclusive print pattern with a large scale design. Made from 100% linen, it is suitable for bedding, drapery, and multipurpose applications. The fabric is reversible and dry clean only, with a fire rating of UFAC Class I / NFPA 260.

title: Wind Chime 02
description_html: Wind Chime 02 is a high-end contemporary fabric from S. Harris, featuring an exclusive print pattern. Made from 100% linen, it is suitable for bedding, drapery, and multipurpose uses. The fabric is reversible and dry clean only, with a large scale abstract design in linen and off white/ivory colors. It exceeds 51,000 double rubs, ensuring durability.

title: Galon
description_html: The Galon design draws inspiration from the upholstery of antique French sofas, often adorned with refined two-tone stripes. This motif is reinterpreted here in a velvet jacquard, shimmering with a sophisticated sheen. Its name references the French ‘galon,’ a decorative ribbon traditionally used to accentuate luxurious textile finishes.

title: Lyra Ecru
description_html: Lyra Ecru is a high-end contemporary fabric from S. Harris, known for its innovative colors and design. It features a soil and stain repellent finish, is Pfas-Free, easy to clean, Oeko Tex Standard 100 certified, mildew resistant, suitable for indoor and outdoor use, and bleach cleanable. It also offers 2,200 hours of light fastness.

title: Lyra Ash
description_html: Lyra Ash is a high-end contemporary fabric from S. Harris, featuring a soil and stain repellent finish. It is made of 100% solution dye acrylic, making it bleach cleanable, mildew resistant, and suitable for indoor and outdoor use. The fabric is eco-friendly, meeting the Oeko Tex Standard 100, and offers 2,200 hours of light fastness.

title: Lyra Vapor
description_html: Lyra Vapor is a high-end contemporary fabric from S. Harris, known for its innovative colors and design. This fabric is made of 100% Solution Dye Acrylic, featuring a soil and stain repellent finish. It is bleach cleanable, mildew resistant, and suitable for indoor and outdoor use. The fabric exceeds 42,000 double rubs, ensuring durability, and is Oeko Tex Standard 100 certified.

title: Lyra Navy
description_html: Lyra Navy is a high-end contemporary fabric from S. Harris, featuring a soil and stain repellent finish. It is made from 100% solution dye acrylic, making it easy to clean and suitable for both indoor and outdoor use. The fabric is bleach cleanable, mildew resistant, and meets the Oeko Tex Standard 100. It also boasts 2,200 hours of light fastness and exceeds 42,000 double rubs, ensuring durability.

title: Lyra 02
description_html: Lyra 02 is a high-end contemporary fabric from S. Harris, featuring a texture plain design. It is made of 100% solution dye acrylic, with a soil and stain repellent finish. The fabric is bleach cleanable, mildew resistant, and suitable for indoor and outdoor use. It exceeds 42,000 double rubs, ensuring durability.

title: Lyra 03
description_html: Lyra 03 is a high-end contemporary fabric from S. Harris, featuring a texture plain design in grey. It is made of 100% solution dye acrylic with a soil and stain repellent finish. The fabric is bleach cleanable, mildew resistant, and suitable for indoor and outdoor use. It exceeds 42,000 double rubs (Wyzenbeek Method) and is Oeko Tex Standard 100 certified.

title: Lyra 04
description_html: Lyra 04 is a high-end contemporary fabric from S. Harris, known for its innovative colors and design. This fabric is made of 100% Solution Dye Acrylic, featuring a soil and stain repellent finish. It is bleach cleanable, mildew resistant, and suitable for both indoor and outdoor use. The fabric exceeds 42,000 double rubs, ensuring durability.

title: Elias Texture Sage
description_html: Elias Texture Sage is a high-end contemporary fabric from S. Harris, featuring a solid texture plain design in light green. It is suitable for upholstery and exceeds 51,000 double rubs, ensuring durability. The fabric is composed of 58% Acrylic, 12% Viscose, 12% Linen, 12% Cotton, and 6% Polyester, with a weight of 31.99 ounces per linear yard. It is made in Italy and passes the 30,000 Martindale test and CA TB 117-2013 fire rating.

title: Elias Texture Grey
description_html: Elias Texture Grey is a high-end contemporary fabric from S. Harris, known for its innovative colors and design. This fabric is suitable for upholstery and features a solid, texture plain design. It is made in Italy and passes 30,000 Martindale test, ensuring durability.

title: Wind Chime Matte Ivory
description_html: Wind Chime Matte Ivory is a high-end contemporary fabric from S. Harris, featuring an exclusive pattern. It is made of 100% linen and is suitable for bedding, drapery, and multipurpose uses. The fabric is reversible and dry clean only, with a large scale abstract print pattern.

title: Avra
description_html: An aura, or ‘avra’ in Greek, is an invisible atmosphere or a feeling surrounding a person, place, or object. This design captures that very essence, with an aura-like effect that seems to float around the drawing. Printed onto a fine fil à fil textile, it uses a generous application of ink to create a design that seems to hover gently on the surface, resulting in an enchanting effect.

title: Allagi
description_html: A design created from genuine sisal, treated and printed to achieve a weathered surface with a strong patina effect. Allagi, meaning Greek for change or transformation, refers to the layered characteristics of this naturally beautiful design.

title: Riverbank
description_html: Inspired by classic tapestries, this woven jacquard wallcovering depicts a lush riverbank with a Japanese crane peeking out of the vegetation. This unique species symbolises good luck and longevity in Japan. The drawing is intentionally pixelated in a nod to the country's mid-century optimism.

title: Bouquet
description_html: A beautiful décor designed after a historic Rijksmuseum tapestry, presented on a slightly textured textile with an airy, open weave. The design comes to life on a slightly textured textile, whose airy, open weave lends the composition a calming and natural appearance.

title: Adrian Ottoman
description_html: A versatile piece perfect for propping up your feet, extra seating, or even as a chic coffee table alternative, adding a touch of cozy luxury and playful style to any room!

title: Amelie Armless Dining Chair
description_html: The Amelie Armless Dining Chair exudes elegance with its sleek, high back, gracefully contoured silhouette, and perfectly cushioned seat, offering a sophisticated and comfortable dining experience.

title: Amelie Banquette
description_html: An extended version of the Amelie Dining Chair, the Amelie Banquette captivates with its high, gracefully curved backrest, elegant winged sides, and inviting seat.

title: Amelie Corner Banquette
description_html: The Amelie Corner Banquette is a sophisticated piece of furniture designed for comfort and style. It features a variety of size options and is available in curated fabric and leather collections. Enhance your piece with in-house water-based finishes, offering unique variations in color and grain.
color_family: Varies with fabric and leather selection

title: Arthur Rocker
description_html: The Arthur Rocker blends modern elegance with organic flow. Its tight seat and back offer a tailored, clean profile, while the chair's gentle rocking motion and durable construction make it both a stylish and functional statement piece. Available with carefully sculpted exposed wood arms in an open-frame design or a minimalist armless design featuring a solid hardwood rocking base.

title: Brisbane Coffee Table
description_html: The Brisbane Coffee Table is part of an architectural series where vertical and horizontal planes, voids and solids have a rhythmic and playful conversation.

title: Brisbane Console
description_html: The Brisbane Console is part of an architectural series where vertical and horizontal planes, voids and solids have a rhythmic and playful conversation.

title: Brisbane Desk
description_html: The Brisbane Desk is part of an architectural series where vertical and horizontal planes, voids and solids have a rhythmic and playful conversation.

title: Brisbane Side Table
description_html: An architectural side table where vertical and horizontal planes, voids and solids have a rhythmic and playful conversation. Available in Ash or Walnut, round or rectangle.

title: Charlotte Swivel Club Chair
description_html: The Charlotte Swivel Club Chair is characterized by its classic armrest, minimal swivel base, and tight seat and back configuration.

title: Charlotte Chair
description_html: Our classic piece that gains elegance and relevance with a new minimal base.

title: Charlie Bench
description_html: Meet the Charlie Bench, a sleek, modern piece with a plush, inviting seat and clean lines that make it perfect for adding a touch of contemporary fun and versatile seating to any room.

title: Finley Ceramic Lamp
description_html: One of the most exciting designs from the Autumn 24 collection, Finley — a large-scale hand-cast table lamp inspired by the abstract shape of a cactus with rippled, asymmetrical fins on all sides. Now available in Crème Brulée and Safari glazes, it somehow seems even more spectacular.

title: Barnacle Lamp
description_html: The Barnacle lamp has a heavy, low, round design and a unique personality due to the individual, sculpted ‘barnacle’ elements each hand-applied, adding to its texture and character. Available in glazes including Almond, Capri, Pudding, Safari or Tigers Eye. It has the feel of something old and interesting, looking at it more closely you notice how much depth there is to each finish.

title: Chloe Chaise
description_html: The Chloe Chaise carries the same playful curves and slightly angled arm as the sofa, offering a unique silhouette. With its plush, tight seat and back, this chaise combines bold, modern design with luxurious comfort, making it a perfect statement piece for lounging in style.

title: Como Floor Lamp
description_html: A beautifully curved wooden base and a chic fabric shade, perfect for adding a touch of modern sophistication and warm ambiance to any room!

title: Como Table Lamp
description_html: A beautifully curved wooden base and a chic fabric shade, perfect for adding a touch of modern sophistication and warm ambiance to any room!

title: Cosmo Club Chair
description_html: The Cosmo Chair features a modern, sculpted design with a generously supportive yet soft back and seat, all supported by a sleek, solid wooden frame.

title: Crew Sectional
description_html: The Crew Sectional extends an invitation to unwind, with modular pieces that wrap you in comfort. Thoughtfully designed with divided backs and soft, generous proportions, each configuration offers a relaxed elegance that adapts effortlessly to your space. From intimate corners to expansive lounges, Crew brings warmth, harmony, and effortless style to every setting.

title: Fabricut
description_html: Fabricut is one of the largest distributors of decorative fabrics and wholesale fabric. We are the brand designers depend on for everyday decorating.

title: Briar Lamp
description_html: The Briar is a handblown glass table lamp inspired by mid-century glassmaking and organic form. Crafted in collaboration with one of our British artisan glassblowers, each piece is unique with layered glass peaks. Available in Clear, Amber, Lemongrass or Denim.

title: Helix Ceiling Light
description_html: The Helix sculptural ceiling light is both kinetic and calming. Shaped in steel by a skilled local metalsmith. Textured and hand‑decorated in a painted finish of your choice — the form casts soft, swirling shadows. A work of art suspended in space.

title: Twisted Compton Ceiling Light
description_html: The Twisted Compton ceiling light adds sinuous rhythm to the original’s sculptural simplicity. Locally forged then hand-finished in our painting studio, it brings movement and texture to contemporary interiors.

title: Lila Ceiling Light
description_html: The Lila ceiling light is inspired by lily pads and flowers, capturing the serene beauty of aquatic flora. Hand‑painted finishes introduce gentle texture. A tiny frog perches delicately on one of the leaves. Also available as a wall light.

title: Hecate Ceiling Light
description_html: The Hecate ceiling light is a bold statement inspired by Greek mythology. A monolithic assembly of welded steel arms with offset angles creates a distinctive silhouette. Hand‑forged in Britain and decorated by hand in our painting studio.

title: Dali Lamp
description_html: The Dali table lamp pays homage to the Parisian avant‑garde. Hand‑forged in mild steel by a skilled local metalsmith, its subtly dimpled surface is finished by hand in our painting studio to create a rich, well‑worn patina.

title: Connie Wall Light Uplight
description_html: The Connie wall light, shaped like a bell, and in the style of a campaign tent, is hand-cast and then textured and hand-painted. Available in two orientations. Also available as a pendant light and in any custom painted finish.

title: Bolla Wall Light
description_html: The Bolla Wall Light is a reinterpretation of the Boublé table lamp, inspired by the work of Georges Jouve. It is part of the Porta Romana collection for Spring 25 and is available in a range of irresistible glazes including Safari, Pudding, Almond, or Myrtle. This product is UL listed.

title: Rupi Ceramic Wall Light Small
description_html: Inspired by the Pinea Trees that guard the southern Italian coastline, the Rupi wall light is sculpted, with textured branches and an undulating, curved up light. Now available in ceramic, glazed in Almond, Myrtle and Pudding, changing the character completely. The Rupi ceramic wall light is available in Large and Small.

title: Scallop Ceramic Wall Light Small
description_html: Since its launch in 2013 the Scallop Shell wall light has transformed bathrooms, kitchens and many other spaces due to its scale and proportion, the versatility of its finishes and the soft light it emits. To extend its influence, we have now created a smaller, more jewel-like scale in ceramic available in a series of different glazes. Capri and Myrtle are strong and eye-catching, while more neutral colours such as Safari give it tremendous scope for versatility.

title: Lila Wall Light
description_html: The Lila wall light brings the serene beauty of aquatic flora to vertical planes. Hand-sculpted lily pads curve from the wall, catching light in their folds like petals at dusk. Hand-painted finishes introduce gentle texture. Also available as a ceiling light.

title: Julius Wall Light
description_html: The Julius wall light is sculpted and cast in-house, then hand-decorated to emphasise its dimpled texture. Finished with a hand-painted gold interior to create a soft and luminous reflection.

title: Camelio Wall Light
description_html: The flowing lines of a seashell inspired the Camelio wall light’s elegant form. Hand-cast and finished with a coarse, stone-like painted finish — Burnt Stone — developed specifically for the piece, it casts a soft, upward glow that enhances intimate spaces. Also available in Sprottle or any painted finish of your choice.

title: Teatro Wall Light
description_html: The Teatro wall light captures the elegance and drama of Roman palazzos and theatres, designed in collaboration with the artist Gergei Erdei. Inspired by the folds of heavy curtains, its hand-sculpted design creates a striking three-dimensional form, gently curving away from the surface of the wall to create an impactful silhouette. Each piece is individually handcrafted from a prototype originally draped from fabric, preserving the artistry of its creation. Subtle imperfections in the surface texture reflect the hand of the maker. Suited to both classic and contemporary interiors. Available in Anziano White or Gilted Verdigris — new finishes developed with Erdei to emphasise the unique draped form.

title: Scallop Wall Light Small
description_html: Since its launch in 2013 the Scallop Shell wall light has transformed bathrooms, kitchens and many other spaces due to its scale and proportion, the versatility of its finishes and the soft light it emits. To extend its influence, we have now created a smaller, more jewel-like scale. Cast in-house and finished by hand in our studio. Available in any painted finish of your choice.

title: Aimee Bed
description_html: Our Aimee Bed offers a simple silhouette with a low profile. Available upholstered or slipcovered to suit your style.
